scenes.title: Суеверные официанты  (Superstitious Waiters)
scenes.summary: Max explains waiter superstitions as a guest spills salt and immediately gets into an argument with the waitress.

scenes.title: Первый гость  (The First Guest)
scenes.summary: The first guest of the day is a rude woman who insults the Nicoise salad and Max's background, prompting Max to talk back.

scenes.title: Байк-шоу во дворе  (Bike Show in the Courtyard)
scenes.summary: Vika defends her staff and clashes with the rude guest, while in the courtyard Chef Barinov catches Katya giving motorcycle rides to the cooks.

scenes.title: Жена префекта  (The Prefect's Wife)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev panics upon learning that Vika and Max insulted the prefect's wife and orders both of them to go beg for her forgiveness.

scenes.title: Взрыв на кухне  (Explosion in the Kitchen)
scenes.summary: Fedya and Senya flirt with Katya while slicing fish, and Barinov scolds Katya in his office for distracting the kitchen.

scenes.title: Машина на пару часов  (A Car for a Couple of Hours)
scenes.summary: Elena recognizes Katya as the motorcyclist who nearly hit her, and Barinov lends Elena his car for a couple of hours.

scenes.title: Метод дедукции  (The Method of Deduction)
scenes.summary: Max tracks down the prefect's wife at a nearby fitness club, and Vika insists on going there with him to apologize.

scenes.title: Талантливая импровизация  (A Talented Improvisation)
scenes.summary: Max convinces the prefect's wife to forgive them by pretending Vika is his pregnant wife, but the lie unravels when Vika goes back for her bag.

scenes.title: Любовь с первого взгляда  (Love at First Sight)
scenes.summary: Caught answering Katya's late-night call, Barinov tells Elena that Katya and sous-chef Lyova have fallen in love and are moving in together.

scenes.title: Переезд вечером  (Moving in the Evening)
scenes.summary: A pedestrian scammer gives Max an idea to save their jobs, while Barinov argues with Katya during her late-night move.

scenes.title: Опасное предложение  (A Dangerous Offer)
scenes.summary: Max offers Rodion Sergeyevich three thousand rubles to dive in front of the prefect's wife's car, and ignores Vika's order to call it off.

scenes.title: Жребий на кухне  (Drawing Lots in the Kitchen)
scenes.summary: Barinov's rumor about Katya spreads through the kitchen, and Ainura slips Lyova's name into the hat when the cooks draw lots for a kiss.

scenes.title: Поздравления для Лёвы  (Congratulations for Lyova)
scenes.summary: Barinov tells Lyova to pretend he is dating Katya for Elena's sake, and seconds later Katya kisses a bewildered Lyova in front of everyone.

scenes.title: Кто на кухне главный  (Who Is Boss in the Kitchen)
scenes.summary: Vika realizes Max is still going through with the car stunt and rushes to stop him, while Katya threatens to expose Barinov's lie.

scenes.title: Две новости  (Two Pieces of News)
scenes.summary: Katya stops mid-sentence while announcing her relationship to Barinov, leading the kitchen crew to conclude that Barinov is her lover.

scenes.title: Повторение — мать учения  (Repetition Is the Mother of Learning)
scenes.summary: Max and Rodion review their blackmail plan, but Rodion jumps in front of the wrong SUV and gets chased off by an angry driver.

scenes.title: Доказательство на телефон  (Proof on the Phone)
scenes.summary: The prefect's wife nearly hits Max and Vika with her SUV, and Rodion bluffs her into backing down by claiming he recorded the crash on his phone.

scenes.title: Игра в покер  (Playing Poker)
scenes.summary: Rodion reveals his phone was a non-working prop from a trash bin, and Elena storms into the kitchen looking for Barinov.

scenes.title: Катя — моя дочь  (Katya Is My Daughter)
scenes.summary: Elena confronts Barinov with the bra from his car, and Barinov is forced to confess to Elena and the whole kitchen that Katya is his daughter.

scenes.title: Верить надо в себя  (You Must Believe in Yourself)
scenes.summary: Everyone reconciles after the day's chaos, and Max reflects that we create and solve our own problems rather than relying on omens.
